name: Agent Warden
author: VanillaGreen
description: Keep your AI agents within their memory and process limits.

showCount.label: Show count
showCount.description: Show the number of running agents or problems beside the shield

hideWhenIdle.label: Hide when idle
hideWhenIdle.description: Hide the shield when no agents run and no problems need attention

notify.label: Notifications
notify.description: Choose alerts for problems, all events or none

requirements.purpose: Shows your agents and provides Agent Warden

warden.label: Warden
warden.hint: Checks whether AI agents stay within their memory and process limits
warden.info: Shows whether the vsys warden is set up, checking agents and reporting problems.

setup.label: Warden setup
setup.hint: Starts the Agent Warden checks in a floating terminal

agents.label: Agents running
agents.info: Counts agent lanes that vsys reports as running. It shows Not reported until vsys reports a count.

lastCheck.label: Last check
lastCheck.info: The time comes from the last status that vsys wrote. If it stops changing, Agent Warden reports stopped checking.

binds.info: Opens the Agent Warden panel, or closes it when it is open.
